reasons: dev-only evidence cannot make a release decision

limitations: The main CLI requires a separately provisioned commands.db and model cache; their tree digest is recorded and setup/download is outside this gate.
Warmed-query samples use fresh CLI processes after filesystem/model caches are warmed; the CLI has no persistent query-server mode.
Example IDs are mapped from user-visible description/command pairs in the pinned candidate bundle; unmapped output is conservatively scored as not acceptable.
Peak memory depends on the host time implementation; missing samples make the performance gate inconclusive.

warmed_query.process_scope: fresh CLI process per sample; filesystem/model cache warmed
fresh CLI process per sample; filesystem/model cache warmed

protocol.primary_outcome: user-visible displayed example IDs and abstentions

candidate.question: In a Bash shell on Unix with GNU coreutils, join chapters/intro.txt and chapters/results.txt, in that order, into release.txt, replacing its existing contents. Give the command.
In a Bash shell on Unix with GNU coreutils, add notices/license.txt and notices/credits.txt to the end of an existing release.txt without discarding its current text. Give the command.
In a Bash shell on Unix with GNU coreutils, display release.txt with a number beside every nonempty line, leaving blank lines unnumbered. Give the command.
In a Bash shell on Unix with GNU grep, look for the literal text rate[0] in measurements.txt; the square brackets must not be interpreted as a regular expression. Give the command.
In a Bash shell on Unix with GNU find, search ./workspace for .rb files and descend into directories reached through symbolic links. Give the command.
In a Bash shell on Unix with GNU grep, emit names of matching files beneath ./workspace separated by NUL bytes so filenames with newlines remain safe. Search for deprecated. Give the command.
In a Bash shell on Unix with sed, transform streamed output from generate-report by replacing every occurrence of pending with ready on each line, printing the transformed stream. Give the pipeline.
In a Bash shell on Unix with GNU sort, sort queue-times.txt numerically and write the result back to queue-times.txt using the sorting command itself. Give the command.
In a Bash shell on Unix with GNU sort, order release-tags.txt by version numbers so v2.9 comes before v2.10. Give the command.
On Debian Linux in Bash, refresh APT package metadata before installing anything. Give the command including the needed privilege elevation.

retrieval_configuration.abstention: raw distance cutoff 0.60 plus scoped negation and unsupported-intent guards
retrieval_configuration.example_selection: retain same-page candidates in the top-k; display the top three after reranking
retrieval_configuration.fusion: dense candidate pool reranked by 0.05 per shared lexical token
query_rewrites: non-Windows file searches with an extension or filename pattern map to the corpus wording Find files by extension
Windows move requests that imply distinct drives map to the corpus wording Move a file or directory across drives
retrieval_configuration.ranking: raw cosine distance minus 0.05 per shared query/candidate token
